Provides high-quality instruction in areas of clinical expertise, consistent with assigned teaching load;
Serves as Course Director for designated courses, as assigned;
Develops and evaluates course materials, learning activities, and assessments in collaboration with program faculty;
Assesses student performance using written assignments, examinations, OSCEs, laboratory practicals, and other evaluation methods;
Participates in academic advising and provides student support and remediation as appropriate to assigned role.
Collaborates with the Director of Didactic Education and program faculty to support the design, delivery, and evaluation of didactic coursework;
Participates in ongoing accreditation-related activities, including data collection, assessment, and self-study processes, as assigned;
Contributes to continuous program and curricular evaluation efforts to ensure compliance with ARC-PA Standards;
Participates in periodic review of program mission, goals, and competencies in collaboration with program leadership and principal faculty.
Participates in admissions-related activities, which may include applicant review, interviews, recruitment, and candidate evaluation;
Supports clinical education through participation in clinical site development, monitoring, or evaluation activities, as assigned and appropriate to part-time appointment.
Serves in appropriate committees in the MSPA Program and the School of Health Sciences;
Maintains professional currency through clinical practice, continuing education, and engagement with the PA profession;
Engages in scholarly and service activities consistent with rank and part-time appointment expectations;
Serves on selected School of Health Sciences or MSPA Program committees, as assigned;
Contributes to interprofessional collaboration across programs within the School of Health Sciences, School of Pharmacy, and Henry E. Riggs School of Applied Life Sciences.

Performs other duties consistent with the scope of a part-time principal faculty appointment as assigned by the Program Director, Director of Didactic Education, Director of Clinical Education, or Dean of the School of Health Sciences.

Demonstrated ability to manage multiple tasks and adapt to changing priorities.
